_comment: Caps disabled and higher budget/candidates to test if k=3 feasibility is search-limited.

stage_distribution._comment: Fraction of students per school stage. Must sum to 1.0. Set KG/ELEM to 0 for a fair constrained-vs-unconstrained comparison (they have walk_radius=0 which is effectively door-to-door).

stage_walk_limits._comment: Override walk radius (metres) per stage. Must match unconstrained (400 m) for a fair comparison — only the safety constraint differs, not the walk budget.

constraints._comment_enabled: Set to false to disable all ride-time caps (effectively uncaps routes for raw comparison).
constraints._comment_bidirectional: If true, a student is only rejected when BOTH morning (home→school) AND afternoon (school→home) rides exceed the cap. If false, only the morning ride is checked (stricter).

algorithm._comment_candidates: Increased candidate pool to test search-budget limits.
algorithm._comment_minimize: If true, run_comparison calls find_minimum_fleet() for each mode, iterating fleet sizes from the theoretical minimum up to buses.count until all students are served. Disabled by default as it multiplies run time by fleet-search depth.

debug._comment: Set any run_mode_* to false to skip that mode — useful for faster iteration when only one mode needs re-running.
